lab_hum: a basement laboratory ambience: soft electrical hum, gentle bubbling beakers, an old pipe ticking, loopable, no voices, no music
hum: a sci-fi ray cannon idling: a low warm electrical hum with a soft sparkle
click: a single small plastic remote control button click, close
zap: a huge cartoon sci-fi ray blast: a deep electric boom with a sparkly magical shimmer, short tail
rattle: glass beakers and metal shelves rattling briefly from a shockwave, short
coo: one pigeon cooing softly, close, natural
chalk: chalk drawing a big circle on a chalkboard, one continuous scrape
tear: a strip of paper torn off a flyer, one quick rip
whoosh: a quick soft cartoon whoosh swish
scribble: a pen scribbling quickly on paper on a clipboard
boom: a big cartoon laboratory explosion: a deep boom, glass rattling, debris pattering down
cough: a woman coughing twice in smoke, light, comedic
thud: a heavy metal fire extinguisher slammed down on a lab bench, a solid clank
pop: a small cartoon explosion puff, a soft pop and a fizzle
stamp: a rubber stamp slammed onto paper on a wall, a firm thump
